name: Beiyan Liu
description: Beiyan Liu — research on strategic interaction, intelligent agents, and the systems they share.
intro: I’m Beiyan, a software engineering graduate from Sun Yat-sen University. My research has explored how self-interested participants share resources, make decisions, and find ways to cooperate.
current: I’m now exploring AI agents and multi-agent systems, with an interest in how individual decisions give rise to collective behavior.
